item.title: Migrating cells and the new science of microchimerism
item.description:
📝 Mothers carry cells that came from their biological children, passed across the placenta when the baby was in the womb. These ‘microchimeric’ cells have been found in every organ that has been studied so far. These giant cells resembled the cells of the placenta, leading Schmorl to suggest that fetal cells passing into the bloodstream of mothers was the norm, rather than the exception.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-04102-4

item.title: LocalFirst: You Keep Using That Word
item.description:
📝 Servers Are Okay Recently, I had someone on Mastodon proclaim that local-first implies that servers aren’t allowed. Local-first apps can sync through a non-peer remote service. If someone else can rug-pull your data out from under you, that software is objectively not local-first.
🔗 Read more: https://www.deobald.ca/essays/2026-01-01-localfirst-you-keep-using-that-word/
